name: dots-studio
description: Four interactive workbenches: replay assumptions, review evidence, inspect failed runs, and build before/after proof packs.

interface.longDescription: Use a CSV, evidence, event, or proof file in an interactive panel. Compare supplied inputs, select context, and export a reproducible replay.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open Scenario Lab, Evidence Canvas, Run Lens, or Proof Pack Builder to inspect my supplied input and prepare a replay.
